Name: (ZZZ) Zhao Replaces Alex (Content Patcher)
Author: Technovoid200
Description:
Content Patcher Mod that replaces bachelor Alex with the adorable Krampus Judge Xiao'Zhao from Zenless Zone Zero.
Mod changes overworld sprites, portraits, NPC tastes, spouse bedroom, and dialogue. Includes narrative adjustments to Heart Events to match Zhao's character.
All romantic events are written under the assumption that all involved characters are canonically adults.

A few cutscenes have minor visual bugs due to my inexperience with SV modding. No gameplay-affecting bugs are known about at this time, please let me know if you run into any.

[b][size=3]Installation
[/size][/b]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][size=3]SMAPI[/size][/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url]
3. Download Alex-To-Zhao
4. Unzip file into StardewValley/Mods
